note: Winneshiek County zoning districts are published only through the Schneider Beacon viewer (County Zoning and Decorah Zoning layers), which is bot-challenged (HTTP 403) and offers no public REST service or file download. City of Decorah publishes its zoning only as static PDF maps (2016-2022). ArcGIS searches for Winneshiek zoning found no district polygon layer; the county's ArcGIS org holds parcels, addresses and boundaries only. ISU's statewide zoning_districts layer has no Winneshiek or Decorah features.
